description:
Apps of the site (install, configure, remove). Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_apps: Which applications are installed / enabled on the site — and which are not — in ONE call.
- get_app: Get one installed app by its type code (returns null if not installed).
- install_app: Install (register) an application on the current site so its features become usable.
- uninstall_app: Uninstall (remove) an installed application from the current site.

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

name: app
